stem.en: A cell is making a lot of protein to send out of the cell. Which path do these proteins follow?

text.en: Ribosomes on ER, then Golgi apparatus, then vesicle to plasma membrane

feedback.en: Yes. This is the route from synthesis to release.

text.en: Lysosome, then nucleus, then chloroplast, then the cell wall of the cell

feedback.en: Lysosomes break material down. This is not the route out.

text.en: Golgi apparatus, then ribosomes, then nucleus, then the mitochondria

feedback.en: Proteins are made before they reach the Golgi apparatus.

text.en: Nucleus, then vacuole, then cytoplasm, then back into the nucleus again

feedback.en: The vacuole is a store, and it is not on this route.

explanation.en: Ribosomes on the ER make the protein. The Golgi apparatus packs it, and a vesicle carries it to the plasma membrane.
